name: Inbound Qualifier
description: Per-call inbound qualifier, as an Attention agent-builder flow. Fires once per analyzed call, scores BANT and ICP fit, and posts a qualification report with a HOT/WARM/COOL/DISQUALIFIED disposition to the team channel. On import, set the connections and the placeholder ids (<...>). Schema matches Attention's agent builder (Activepieces); on a different platform use inbound-qualifier.md.

trigger.name: trigger
trigger.displayName: When one of my calls is analyzed

nextAction.name: qualify_lead
nextAction.displayName: Score BANT and ICP fit for the inbound lead

input.prompt: You are the Inbound Qualifier agent, qualifying the lead on THIS analyzed call (title: {{trigger.attributes.title}}). Pull firmographics synced to the call from the CRM (company size, industry, employee count, whether they are an existing customer). Score each BANT dimension 0-3 with one line of transcript evidence: Budget (3 confirmed amount, 2 partial, 1 implied via paid competitor, 0 missing), Authority (3 decision-maker, 2 influencer who knows the process, 1 implied by title, 0 unclear), Need (3 specific quantified pain + urgency, 2 general problem, 1 implied, 0 none), Timeline (3 specific date, 2 directional, 1 triggering event, 0 none). Total out of 12. Rate ICP fit GOOD / PARTIAL / POOR on industry, size, use case, tech stack, geography. Combine into a disposition: HOT (10-12 + GOOD), WARM (7-9, or 10+ with PARTIAL), COOL (4-6), DISQUALIFIED (0-3, or POOR ICP regardless). If the call is an existing customer asking about a new product, flag as EXPANSION not inbound. Output the exact report format in inbound-qualifier.md -> Output: lead/company/date/rep/score/BANT/ICP header, the per-dimension BANT breakdown with evidence, ICP fit notes, recommended next steps, and key quotes. Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_report
nextAction.displayName: Post the qualification report to the team channel
